items.title: Nintendo Direct 2026 年 9 月：开始时间、如何观看以及期待什么
items.summary: With yesterday's Legend of Zelda Direct in the bag, it's time to take a broader look at what's coming to Switc

content.v: With yesterday's Legend of Zelda Direct in the bag, it's time to take a broader look at what's coming to Switch consoles with the September Nintendo Direct. Yesterday's broadcast was mostly focused on the upcoming remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time , but today, we're expecting to see a whole lot more than just the hero in green. In case you can't make it, we'll be covering each new announcement and trailer as they drop, so keep on scrolling to see all the reveals and hit your F5 key to refresh your feed as we dive into what should be a massive Nintendo Direct presentation.
How to watch the September Nintendo Direct
Once again, you can watch the presentation through Nintendo's official YouTube and Twitch channels.
Nintendo Direct start time

Hope you're in the mood to start your day bright and early, as the broadcast starts at 7 AM PT / 10 AM ET on September 9 . Nintendo says the show will run for roughly 45 minutes, and it'll be followed by a Nintendo Treehouse livestream that'll feature gameplay from select titles.
What to expect

That's the big question, isn't it? As you'd expect, Nintendo is keeping quiet ahead of the Direct, but we're expecting the usual first-party games, upcoming titles from third-party partners, and related news.

According to leakers , we could be in for a bumper reveal of Switch exclusives, as they're teasing a new Super Smash Bros. fighting game, a brand-new Star Fox, and a new 3D Mario to end the broadcast with a bang. Nintendo may need to pull a few heavy hitters out, considering that the Switch 2 price increased by $50 earlier this month, and having a stacked selection of upcoming games could be just what the company needs to start shifting units.

Could we also get a new look at Pokemon Winds and Waves? Pokemon continues to be one of the biggest franchises on Nintendo hardware, and we wouldn't say no to a quick look at the game's region or even a few new pocket monsters.

items.title: 好莱坞变性演员没片拍了！刚拍完史诗大作《奥德赛》
items.summary: 曾凭借《盗梦空间》等作品走红的变性演员艾略特·佩吉（原名艾伦·佩吉）近日做客播客节目，谈到了自己出演克里斯托弗·诺兰新片《…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090955596501.png
曾凭借《盗梦空间》等作品走红的变性演员艾略特·佩吉（原名艾伦·佩吉）近日做客播客节目《On Film... With Kevin McCarthy》，谈到了自己出演克里斯托弗·诺兰新片《奥德赛》后的职业状态。
艾略特·佩吉于2020年公开宣布自己为跨性别男性，此后以男性身份继续生活和从事演艺工作。此次出演诺兰新片《奥德赛》，也是他近年来受到关注的重要影视项目之一。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090956201237.png
变性前形象：
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090956211597.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090956228416.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090956238157.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090957053718.png
节目中，主持人提到，考虑到《奥德赛》是一部由诺兰执导、拥有豪华阵容的商业大片，佩吉出演该片后或许会迎来更多新的演艺机会。不过，佩吉表示，实际情况并没有像预想中那样发展。
他表示，自己曾以为“会有各种新的机会到来”，但现实并非如此。
佩吉同时谈到了目前的职业状态。他表示，如今自己更加清楚希望参与什么样的作品，也希望未来能够继续寻找真正感兴趣的项目。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090957219682.png
在《奥德赛》中，艾略特·佩吉饰演西农。该片由克里斯托弗·诺兰执导，改编自古希腊史诗《奥德赛》，汇集了众多演员阵容。佩吉此前也曾与诺兰合作，在《盗梦空间》中饰演阿丽雅。
此外，佩吉还表示，随着自身经历和环境变化，如今获得角色的过程比过去更加困难，并希望未来能够通过主动寻找机会参与更多优秀作品。

items.title: 24岁百万粉丝吃播博主离世 畸形暴食吃播该全面叫停
items.summary: 9月4日，百万粉丝吃播博主“干饭莹莹”的父母发布讣告，确认其于8月17日离世，年仅24岁。这起令人痛心的事件，再度将以透支生命博取…

content.v: 9月4日，百万粉丝吃播博主“干饭莹莹”的父母发布讣告，确认其于8月17日离世，年仅24岁。悲剧根源为长期暴食催吐引发重度低钾血症，血钾最低至2.3mmol/L，最终诱发心脏骤停。这起令人痛心的事件，再度将以透支生命博取流量的畸形吃播业态推上舆论风口。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090950097388.jpg
据公开信息，“干饭莹莹”在离世前三天发布了最后一条视频。镜头里她自述“反复吃，钾流失，住院了”，并郑重叮嘱粉丝：“身体永远是第一位”。这段遗言，成为畸形吃播赛道最沉重的警示。
而“干饭莹莹”并非该业态的唯一受害者，类似悲剧早已接连上演：吃播博主泡泡龙29岁因心衰离世；闻味哥长期带病直播，最终因尿毒症去世；三千哥在直播中喝下4瓶白酒后身亡。一个个年轻生命的逝去，不断敲响警钟，流量红利之下，这条赛道暗藏致命风险。
畸形吃播背后，是一套完整的流量变现陷阱。平台算法之下，食量越大、场面越夸张，越容易获得更高流量，收益直接和观看数据挂钩。博主被流量裹挟，即便身体频频发出警报，也难以停下“狂吃表演”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090950098888.jpg
为维持“大胃王”人设，行业内衍生出各类造假手段：镜头外催吐、视频剪辑实现假吃、AI换脸与替身拍摄、色素调制虚假辣度、安排“嘴替”拍摄近景画面，用欺骗方式营造超强进食假象。在流量积累成型后，博主便依托“狂吃不胖”人设带货减肥产品，利用粉丝信任收割佣金，形成一套以健康为代价的变现链条。
事实上，针对宣扬暴饮暴食的吃播，法律早已划出红线。2021年施行的《反食品浪费法》明确规定，禁止制作、发布、传播宣扬量大多吃、暴饮暴食的音视频内容。
抖音等平台此前也对大量违规账号采取封禁处置。但治理之下，部分博主不断变换手段规避审核，通过深夜开播、标注“非一人食用”、包装成“带货试吃”等方式，继续进行极限进食表演，监管与违规内容持续上演“猫鼠游戏”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090950094293.jpg
以生命换取流量，这样的畸形吃播不能再继续放任。这类内容不仅损害博主自身生命健康，造成大量食物浪费，还容易误导青少年，传递不健康饮食观念。
面对屡禁不止的暴食类吃播，需要压实平台主体责任，升级识别审核机制，深挖账号背后的带货产业链，加大违规处罚力度。同时，也呼吁公众理性看待吃播内容，抵制猎奇暴食表演，拒绝为带血的流量买单。
民以食为天，美食的本意是享受与滋养，绝非拿生命博眼球的表演。悲剧一再发生，全社会应当形成共识：以暴食催吐为噱头的畸形吃播，该全面叫停。

items.title: 硬蹭时之笛热度！美国白宫发《特朗普传说》预告
items.summary: 在《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》公布发售日期与售价之际，美国白宫官方X账号发布了一段名为《特朗普传说》（The Legend of Trump）…

content.v: 在《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》公布发售日期与售价之际，美国白宫官方X账号发布了一段名为《特朗普传说》（The Legend of Trump）的游戏预告。
视频欣赏：
该预告片以任天堂经典作品《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》的宣传风格为基础进行改编，将美国总统唐纳德·特朗普作为游戏主角，制作成一段类似游戏预告的视频。
视频截图：
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090935144073.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090935154961.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090935176032.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090935189271.png
视频中，首先展示了“像素风”特朗普站在白宫前的画面，镜头围绕角色进行环绕展示，随后展现玩家操控特朗普在场景中移动以及处理事务的画面。
预告中还加入了办公场景，字幕介绍称：“特朗普总统正在努力工作，以‘让美国再次伟大’（Make America Great Again）。”
当然，《特朗普传说》并非一款正式商业游戏，而是白宫官方账号发布的创意宣传视频。视频借用了《塞尔达传说》系列经典名称、画面风格以及角色冒险形式进行二次创作。

items.title: 神作翻新遭痛批！《塞尔达时之笛》画风被吐槽
items.summary: 对于《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版的实机演示，玩家们有着不同的看法，你怎么看？

content.v: 由你来说： 对于《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版的实机演示，玩家们有着不同的看法，你怎么看？
《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版于昨日正式公开了首支实机演示。
作为游戏史上的立碑之作，本次重制版的实机表现公布后，却并未如预期般获得玩家社区一致的赞美，其独特的美术画风与重制方式的选择在社交平台上引发了极大的争议。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090930542199.jpg
有博主直言不讳地评价道：“哦不，《时之笛》重制版完全走到了我个人期待的反面。虽然这很主观，但这种几乎 1:1 的复刻配上他们选的美术风格真的不是我的菜。在我看来，它看起来就像多年前那种粉丝用虚幻引擎自制的‘假重制’视频一样。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090931043395.jpg
随着实机演示的扩散，社区网友对本作的视觉表现、建模细节以及重制诚意展开了激烈讨论：
“角色的设计真的让我感觉很不舒服（我还是个玩着原版长大的人）。他们本应该采用更有风格化一些的美术设计。”
“当年那些吐槽渲染画风《风之杖》的人要为今天买单。这游戏要是用卡通渲染风格本来会非常帅，结果现在搞出了这种尴尬又卡通又写实的怪异风格。真得‘谢谢’2002年的那群人。”
“眼睛和鼻子是我觉得最违和的地方，我也说不上来为什么。还有他的衣服看起来有点过头了，现在看起来更像某种超大号的树叶部落服饰，而不是原版那种‘绿色Polo衫’的感觉。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090931587645.png
“凭借完全重塑的视觉效果、全语音配音过场动画、扩充的角色对话、交响乐团演奏的音乐、重做过的视角与移动控制等等，林克1998年的里程碑式冒险在全新的时代获得了新生。”
“我个人挺喜欢的，这很接近1:1的重制。游戏里会有新的对话、语音配音、重制版音乐、像冲刺和加速游泳这样的新玩法要素，以及全新的美术风格。我很想看到老地方和BOSS被重新设计后的样子。”

items.title: 时之笛RE故意保留加载画面！任天堂：原版游戏的精髓
items.summary: 据IGN报道，在昨晚的任天堂直面会上，任天堂公开了更多关于《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》的信息，其中一个关键细节是，任天堂刻意…

content.v: 据IGN报道，在昨晚的任天堂直面会上，任天堂公开了更多关于《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》的信息，其中一个关键细节是，任天堂刻意在《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》中加入了加载画面，以“保留原版游戏的精髓”。
实机 视频欣赏：
系列制作人青沼英二表示：“顺便说一下，每当你在区域之间移动时，都会出现加载画面。这是我们刻意保留下来的设计，为的是保留原版游戏的精髓。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090921316798.jpg
让我们花点时间来分析一下这段演示。在1998年的原版《塞尔达传说：时之笛》中，以及前后许多其他游戏里，加载画面都是开发者暂停游戏体验、为玩家加载即将探索的新区域的一种方式。除了科奇里森林与海拉鲁平原之间原本过渡时前后的部分过场动画之外，玩家实际上只会在几秒钟内暂时失去对林克的操作控制。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090921386190.jpg
而《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》的过渡则看起来似乎更加无缝。虽然目前尚不清楚目前的演示是否会和正式版完全一致，但在这段演示中，我们可以看到玩家在黑屏出现之前一直能够操控林克。随后画面被黑色覆盖，右下角还出现了一个小型三角神力Logo，这一状态持续了大约3秒，之后幼年林克重新出现在画面中。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090921447807.jpg

items.title: 《黎明行者》多部续作确认 纵览多时代 主角长命百岁
items.summary: 由前CDPR资深开发者组成的Rebel Wolves工作室推出的暗黑幻想动作RPG新作《黎明行者之血》近日迎来重大情报。

content.v: 由前CDPR资深开发者组成的Rebel Wolves工作室推出的暗黑幻想动作RPG新作《黎明行者之血》近日迎来重大情报。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090912528701.jpg
官方已经为该IP规划了名为“黎明行者传奇”（The Dawnwalker Saga）的多部续作，并公布了整个系列未来的宏大发展方向。
核心细节如下：
每一部续作都将设定在不同的时代、地点与文化背景下，整个系列的故事线将横跨数个世纪、各大洲以及全球多种文化。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090913573031.jpg
因为吸血鬼衰老速度极慢、拥有悠长寿命，主角柯恩（Coen of Laslea）将作为整个系列贯穿始终的绝对主角，见证并亲历不同历史时期的沧桑巨变。
玩家在前作中的关键抉择将产生深远影响，《黎明行者之血》的通关存档可以继承至未来的续作中，你的选择将在后续的多部游戏中得到体现。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090914048797.png
系列中的每一款作品都是拥有独立完整剧情的单机大作，不会采用悬念结局或遗留未解决的剧情，也不会加入时空穿越概念。但在这些独立故事背后，有一条贯穿始终的宏大主线。

items.title: Wi-Fi 8 即将到来，以下是我们在 Computex 上看到的两款路由器，它们应该很快就会上市
items.summary: Unsurprisingly, Asus ROG is launching its Wi-Fi 8 routers with an extreme gaming monster.

content.v: Last week at IFA 2026 TP-Link announced two new Wi-Fi 8 routers —the Archer 9 Ultra and the Deco 8 Ultra—though the actual price and release date aren’t yet known, other than availability being later this year.

While TP-Link claimed these are the first Wi-Fi 8 routers to be revealed, this isn't quite the case: Asus showed off its Wi-Fi 8 ROG Rapture GT-BN98 at Computex in June, and we were there having a proper gawk. This is a premium gaming router that’s loaded up with features and game optimisations, and with classic completely-OTT ROG looks.

Asus also showed its more mainstream ZenWiFi BN12 at Computex for normal people. Pricing and availability have not yet been announced—though review samples of the ROG Rapture GT-BN98 are expected to be available very soon, so it’s not far off.

Wi-Fi 8 isn’t so much about boosting speed over Wi-Fi 7: stability under heavy load is the main objective of the new standard, as we continue to saturate the Wi-Fi airwaves with ever more demanding uses.

Compared to Wi-Fi 7, the new Wi-Fi 8 standard is far from being a premium speed boost for the sake of it like past Wi-Fi iterations, and is more of a user experience enhancement that addresses some of the issues that can hamper Wi-Fi 7 and its predecessors in the real-world. It’s more reliable, faster at long distance and even improves the performance of existing older/weaker networked devices. Its technologies facilitate almost double speed at mid-to-long range, almost double IoT network coverage, deliver lower latencies in crowded Wi-Fi environments, and better handling of heavy network traffic across multiple connected devices.
Which all adds up nicely for a modern gamer’s device or stream-congested home.
The ROG Rapture GT-BN98 Pro Wi-Fi 8 is pitched at gamers, and besides the standard Wi-Fi 8 gains it packs in the usual suite of ROG gaming router enhancements.

Its AI-powered Adaptive QoE technology actively analyses packet content and behaviour patterns in real time, and automatically identifies the requirements and priorities of each application and dynamically allocates network resources using bandwidth monitoring techniques. For gamers that means prioritising game and related traffic, and preventing unwanted bandwidth hogs from interrupting your game at an inconvenient time.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6xhuHWKJaq3d6oqBkCCCMW.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QQPk5Vog9ii53zZWG2Tmta.png
It also includes a much more intuitive interface with intensive details covering both the environment and all your connected devices.
It’s got dual 10Gbps ports (one with preconfigured game optimisation settings) and 2.5Gbps W/LAN ports. So, no compromises for Ethernet-connected PCs and devices.

The more pedestrian Asus ZenWiFi BN12 will be available as a standalone router or multi-node mesh system, with MLO backhaul between nodes that banishes the huge performance drop-off associated with many mesh networks. Each node sports dual-10Gbps and triple-2.5Gbps ports.

Both models provide a plethora of network monitoring tools, VPN integration, multi-SSID operation and server functionality. Both also include Asus’ triple-level network security with AiProtection including parental controls, for free, without an ongoing subscription.

But should you upgrade as soon as these become available? If you’re on Wi-Fi 7 definitely not, as Wi-Fi 8 client devices such as phones or laptops—or even PCIe or USB adaptors—will likely follow actual router availability by weeks or even months before being widely available.
But if you're due for a router upgrade soon, Wi-Fi 8 offers all the benefits of Wi-Fi 7 (and then some), so upgrading to one of the new Wi-Fi 8 routers makes more sense in terms of future proofing.

content.v: 光荣特库摩旗下 GUST 工作室 打造的《卡莉亚的炼金工房 ～夜之王国与追忆之道标~》将于27年2月24日发售。本作故事发生在《优米雅的炼金工房》所描绘的阿拉迪斯大陆事件两年之后。大陆深陷"玛那枯竭"危机，而身为开拓团冒险者的新主角卡莉亚（CV：浅见香月）却是一名失忆者——她拥有"吞食万物、知晓其特性"的神秘能力，却对自己的过去一无所知。
某日，她与生物学者塞尔维奥（CV：田丸笃志）在调查遗迹时，意外发现了横亘于大陆地底的广袤神秘世界，追寻记忆与传承的旅途就此展开。本作围绕"进食"这一全新机制构建了独特的成长系统。
https://image.gcores.com/63c0398c4e22a9d507e31252ba088b10-700-506.webp

items.title: 公司希望消灭物理媒体，因为它适合他们，但大盒 PC 游戏包装刚刚获得了第二次机会
items.summary: It's now much easier to take the DIY approach.

content.v: If you were alive and sentient in the nineties you probably harbour some fondness for the "big box" PC games of yore. Back then, rather than buy an ephemeral digital license for a game, you'd head to a store to buy a huge box bedecked in lavish art, inside which you'd find a handful of 3.5-inch floppy discs or a CD-ROM, usually a substantial glossy manual, and if you were lucky, maybe even some extras like stickers or drink coasters.

There's been renewed interest in the ye olde big box PC game, especially in the wake of Sony's announcement it will discontinue physical PlayStation games. Some proactive folk have gone viral for manufacturing their own physical Steam games . Now GOG has offered its own alternative: printable big boxes based on scans of real commercial packages from the golden era of game packaging.

In collaboration with Big Box Collection—which is a fan-operated trove of big box 3D scans—GOG is now offering those 3D scans with five entries in its GOG Preservation Program. These include the newly added Star Trek: 25th Anniversary and Armikrog, while games already in the Preservation Program including Descent, Hitman: Codename 47, and Myst will also receive the treatment.

"We’re delivering flat, printable versions of the same box art, so you can cut, fold, and glue your own physical big box at home," reads GOG's announcement . "A proper papercraft project for anyone who misses shelves full of PC game boxes."

It's a neat idea for people who long for the days when they could display their collection on actual shelves. As the capriciousness of so-called digital ownership becomes clearer with time, and as streaming platforms become more cynical, exploitative and AI-flooded, people in their droves are returning to physical media. Revenue from CD sales, for instance, have jumped 58% in 2026 compared to 2025. That's a pretty good result for a format long considered dead.

The elephant in the room here is that obviously GOG isn't selling physical discs. But of all the major PC games platforms, it's best positioned to offer this service: GOG is DRM free, so there's nothing stopping you from burning the game files onto a CD or DVD, all the better to archive on your physical shelves.

items.title: AMC 影院将在美国各地的部分影院转播 2026 年火箭联盟世界锦标赛决赛
items.summary: The 2026 Rocket League World Championship Finals will be broadcast at 50 AMC Theaters across the United States

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/rocket-league-world-championships-amc-theaters-1788910406554.jpg
The 2026 Rocket League World Championship Finals will be broadcast at 50 AMC Theaters across the United States.
The Finals take place on Sunday, September 20. That day, fans can show up to participating AMC Theaters nationwide and catch the action on the big screen.

The competition will stream live from Dickies Arena in Fort Worth, Texas, where 20 teams will throw down for the chance to win $300,000 out of a staggering $1.2 million prize pool. The total broadcast will last approximately eight hours.

Tickets are currently on sale at participating theaters, with adult tickets priced at $19.49 ($22.18 if booked online). Only a few of these theaters are showing the Finals, and tickets are selling out fast, so make sure to grab yours quickly if you want a front row seat to see who gets crowned the 15th Rocket League World Champions.

Most major esports tournaments are streamed on Twitch, with viewers receiving special drops that can be earned by simply watching on the platform. AMC Theaters has already thought of this, and is giving fans commemorative Rocket League tickets that include codes to redeem the drops that they would normally get watching the competition on Twitch.

“Such a big part of the magic of movie theatres is their ability to bring people together for unforgettable shared experiences, and a live event like the Rocket League World Championship is a great example of that," Ellen Copaken, SVP of Business Development for AMC Theatres, said in a press release. "We're excited to give fans the opportunity to watch esports' biggest stage unfold live on massive screens, surrounded by fellow Rocket League fans.”
A full list of the participating theaters can be found at the link embedded here.

This isn’t the first time an esports tournament has been shown at a theater; last year, the League of Legends Worlds Finals in Chengdu, China were shown in select theaters across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Riot did the same for the Valorant Champions Paris Finals , which also screened in certain cinemas throughout EMEA.

AMC’s decision to broadcast esports is the latest unique move from the brand after it founded a film distribution company to help get smaller films into theaters. With small-budget projects like Obsession and Markiplier’s Iron Lung proving to be hits at the box office, AMC is stepping in to capitalize on the trend and bring art to the masses.

items.title: 亚马逊《炸弹克星》棋盘游戏价格降至历史最低价
items.titleEn: The Bomb Busters Board Game Drops to Its Lowest Price Ever at Amazon

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/board-game-of-the-year-award-1752524536846-1788904248533.png
Bomb Busters 现在在亚马逊限时享受 30% 的折扣，这是我们在合作桌游上见过的最低价格。距离这款游戏被评为2025德国桌游最高荣誉“Spiel des Jahres”已经过去了一年多的时间。
对于那些不熟悉德国“年度游戏”奖项的人来说，这在桌面社区中是一件相当大的事情。获胜的消息传出后，这款游戏在北美几乎所有地方都卖光了。如果您的收藏中还没有它，那么这次折扣是购买它的好时机。
至于《Bomb Busters》到底是什么类型的游戏，大家可以从名字中寻找答案。这是一款战略合作棋盘游戏，2 至 5 名玩家尝试驱散炸弹并切断正确的电线。总共包含 66 个不同的任务，难度级别也逐渐增加。如果您曾经玩过视频游戏“继续说话，无人爆炸”，您应该知道会发生什么。
总而言之，《炸弹克星》的伟大之处在于它是任何人都可以玩的游戏。这是一款适合家庭或与一小群朋友一起出去玩的绝佳棋盘游戏。典型的游戏只需要大约 30 分钟的时间，因此你们可以快速合作来消除炸弹，然后根据需要继续进行其他事情。
另请查看亚军 Flip 7
虽然《Bomb Busters》赢得了去年的奖项，但值得指出的是，亚军也是一款出色的游戏。这是一款有趣且快节奏的纸牌游戏，价格非常实惠。与炸弹克星类似，游戏玩法快速且易于学习。 IGN 在我们的评论中给了它 9 分（满分 10 分），称其为“无论您玩纸牌游戏的经验如何、收藏的大小，甚至您的年龄如何，它都是一个简单的推荐”。

items.title: 出埃及记：你需要知道的五件事
items.summary: Exodus: Five Things You Need to Know

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/03/exodus-blogroll-1788461357494.jpg

We’re rapidly approaching three years since the world got its first look at Exodus. A lot has happened in the world since 2023 - many games have come and gone in the span between. It would be fair to question if Exodus has kept pace with the movements of the market.

Happily, all this time has gone to good use. Developer Archetype Entertainment, backed by legendary tabletop game publisher Wizards of the Coast, are now on the downhill run on this science fiction sprawler and it’s finally time to wrap our mitts around a gamepad and get stuck in. Archetype is rightly avoiding Grand Theft of Your Time in November and touching down on April 7, 2027 instead, so now’s the perfect time for a progress check-in.
Here are Five Things You Need to Know about Exodus.
1. YOU’VE GOT TO STOP THE ROT
Exodus’ story focuses on the practical and sometimes heartbreaking effects of time dilation, where days of interstellar space travel for the player mean decades passing for loved ones back home.

Players take on the role of “Traveler” Jun Aslan, this game’s Commander Shephard, but with heartthrob hair and a charming disposition. He is the stalwart son of famed veteran Traveler, Orion Aslan, but through happenings as yet unclear, Jun starts the game as a humble salvager on a dying world overrun by a technovirus known as The Rot. To save your planet, which every good hero should aim to do, you must reclaim your father’s legacy and stop The Rot.

Still with me? Good. The Rot, as we understand it, is a byproduct of The Celestials: descendants of the first humans. They’ve evolved far beyond humanity’s capabilities - around 40,000 years more advanced, and are a persistent threat to humanity’s continued existence in Exodus.

To further complicate things, Jun is also a genetic crosspoint of sorts; he can, for reasons still unclear, interact with Celestial technology, imbuing him with special active abilities - sort of a techo-blend of Psy attacks and quasi-magical spells (but I’m sure the game has detailed lore that will explain the context better than I can). In practice, just like Mass Effect, you’ll be upgrading these abilities throughout the journey, triggering all sorts of cool effects, environmental modifiers, attacks, defensive techniques and so on.
2. THE UNIVERSE IS FULL OF “AWAKENED” BEINGS

The team allowed us to play through one mostly complete mission on PC, abridged in a couple places to keep the pace moving (and presumably to cut minor story moments). We meet our swarthy hero Jun Aslan aboard his sleek vessel (reminiscent of the N7, in fact), joined by a multi-racial, multi-species crew.

Let’s talk about The Awakened. The universe is teeming with animals, as it turns out. The Awakened are animals have been granted human intellect through some means, and this is a very good thing for players, because in addition to all sorts of interesting alien races, you can now expect some brilliant dealings with all kinds of talking critters, and oh boy, they all have plenty to say about how cruddy and exploitative humans generally are. They’re not wrong!

The team have revealed eight of Jun’s companions so far - and teased that there are still some to be revealed. The current roster includes: Tom Vargas, Elise Charroux, Phaedra Nath, Salt, Houston, Suliman, C.C. Orlev and Emrys, but alledgedly there are 11 crew to find. One standout is an Awakened anthropomorphic wolf named Houston, who, curiously, is your adopted brother.
The recent Gamescom trailer also introduced us to Salt - a blunt, bounty-hunting Awakened Octopus in a mech suit. She is a sniper who can use her ink as a smokescreen to provide cover in combat.

As an aside, it seems like Octopi are having their moment, perhaps propelled into popularity through the 2020 film “My Octopus Teacher”. Then came The Boys’ romantic (albeit warped) relationship between an octopus and The Deep. I digress, but in Exodus, you can look forward to meeting lots of Awakened species, tentacled or otherwise.
3. THIS IS HOW EXODUS PLAYS

Back to the mission, and Jun’s goal is to set down inside the hangar bay of a large orbital space station that houses a race of Awakened Frogs known as the Kay from the planet Lidon. The Kay have been exploited and driven into exile - but all is not lost! One Kay, catchily named 42C, has developed a soft spot for human music - thumping heavy electronica - and is eager to help guide you.

Your offside for the mission is the equally swishy-haired, but slightly stiff Suliman: a dark-eyed representative of a powerful faction that Jun must align with. Why? Because their support will enable you to get your hands on some critical parts that will allow your ship to travel between star systems. There’s no free lunch, even in the cold of space.

Anyway, the opening sequence lets us appreciate the gorgeous facial animations delivering engaging and nicely performed dialogue sequences from decorated Narrative Director and writer Drew Karpyshyn and his team of ex-Bioware, Naughty Dog and 343 alumni. Again, there’s an instant fee ling of Biowaresque familiarity, thanks to a sharp script, infusing the characters and scenarios with plenty of personality.

In practice, it’s clear the team has studied what makes the genre leaders successful. Mass Effect’s team directing mechanics are implemented almost identically, for one. That’s a good thing, insofar as I was able to jump into a mission that takes place a couple hours into the start of the game and not feel completely overwhelmed.

We start in a micro-gravity environment, making our way into the guts of the ship. Jun can sprint, jump, grapple, dive behind cover, roll and dodge attacks, and scale up ledges. Jun’s an agile fella and you’ll rarely feel constrained.

In true action-RPG form, you’ll be spending a good portion of time dealing out commands to your squad in slowed-down time. The radial menu pops up and pumps the brakes on the game speed, allowing you precious seconds to target enemies and queue up your squad’s preferred attacks and manoeuvres. You can, of course, just duke it out guns akimbo, but the game urges you to play around with a raft of abilities: aerial bombardments, stealthy teleportation attacks and such. These squad attacks can be timed up for combo damage too, which is a nice touch.

We pushed forward through hallways and tunnels, activating mechanical ledges, grappling up platforms and activating switches. You’ll be collecting resources, crafting ammo, unlocking new items, weapons and skills as you do. It’s what you’d expect in a game of this nature, and so far, Exodus is delivering the goods.
4. YOU’LL BE MAKING HARD DECISIONS

Eventually we meet up with a couple of Awakened Frogs, who compel you to help them - and put you at odds with Suliman at times. The story doesn’t shy away from dark themes and puts you in positions that force you to make hard decisions. Do you sell out an entire species for immediate gain, or risk it all and keep your chin held high?

Later, I came upon an injured enemy and I was posed with further ethical dilemmas. Yes, you’ll be choosing from morally grey responses to many situations and your teammates will judge you based on how just firm your backbone is. In Mass Effect, you were leaning towards Paragon or Renegade. In the Exodus-verse, your choices put you in either “Paladin” or “Immortal” baskets. I’m a softie (Paladin), because I like to help the injured, rather than doom them - but you do you.

content.v: 众所周知，《GTA6》可以操控两名主角杰森和露西娅，二人性格迥异。杰森性格阴郁、谨慎内敛。露西娅则更具野心、行事大胆且个性张扬。不过两个主角的玩法似乎也各不相同。该情报来自游戏博主MikeShowSha的预览体验，以及他与本作联合开发总监罗布・纳尔逊的对话。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260909/1788908832_512019_jpg_r.jpg
《GTA6》杰森和露西娅拥有截然不同的战斗风格。露西娅招式讲究技巧，动作敏捷，擅长踢拳与综合格斗。反观杰森，则采用传统的街头斗殴风格，依靠重拳和蛮力制敌。玩家操控不同角色时，近战搏斗会带来截然不同的游玩体验。
此外在特定场景下，玩家还可以向AI搭档下达具体指令。AI队友在追逐、抢劫任务中具备场景判断能力。而游戏还加入了情景指令功能，举个例子，玩家操控杰森向AI控制的露西娅下达“快点”指令，露西娅就会加快行动，在车流之中激进穿梭。该机制会大幅提升高强度任务里双人互动的层次感。

content.v: 英伟达已正式推出DLSS 5供用户尝鲜，这项神经渲染技术目前已取得了一些非常有趣的成果。然而，由于其输出效果有时差异较大，且DLSS 5会带来一定的性能损耗，一些人认为这项技术表明英伟达已经偏离了DLSS的初衷。
然而，也有人承认喜欢它的效果。尤其值得一提的是，这项技术能够极大地提升老游戏的视觉效果，堪比免费重制。
最近，社交媒体上分享了一段《战地3》开启DLSS 5后的画面，效果非常震撼。
DICE官方为《战地3》所做的工作，考虑到这款游戏的年代，已经显得非常出色了，但将英伟达的最新技术注入到游戏中，却带来了近乎照片级的逼真视觉效果。
同样，这项技术在《波斯王子5：遗忘之沙》这样的游戏中也带来了超出预期的效果。 在这款游戏中，DLSS 5似乎突出了游戏的暗色调，赋予了这款游戏现代感，稍加调整即可作为一款不错的重制版。
以上仅列举了部分示例，足以说明DLSS 5在运行良好时如何有效地为各种游戏带来伪重制效果。即使是像2011年的《使命召唤8：现代 战争 3》这样的游戏，在使用英伟达的神经渲染技术后，也能展现出显著的视觉提升。
当然，DLSS 5的输出效果并非完美无缺，许多人仍然对其对游戏未来发展的影响持保留态度。有人甚至称其为一种高级滤镜，与许多PC玩家几十年来一直在使用的着色器模组并无太大区别。

content.v: 最近杭州艺创小镇的《黑 神话 》首家官方零售店迎来开业一周年，门店完成整体展陈升级，开启全新“风起黄昏”主题，取材游戏第二章黄风岭篇章，一大批全新1比1大型雕塑正式对外展出。
游科主美杨奇在社交平台晒出门店现场实拍图，并感慨道：“看预算差点晕过去，看现场又活过来了，像模又像样，拍的也棒棒。不白跑一趟”，引发玩家热议。本次焕新替换大部分旧展品，一共上线七组全新大型艺术装置，把黄风岭的游戏场景实体化还原。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260909/1788907908_331530.jpg
重点展品
老猴雕塑：使用铂金硅胶，毛发由工艺师手工制作45个工作日，皮肤、毛发、神态极度写实，不少游客凑近误以为是真人。老猴坐于巨型枯木之上，充满沧桑氛围感。
黄风大圣雕塑：占据展厅C位，还原黄风大圣扛灵吉菩萨佛头的名场面。
亢金星君：高度还原游戏女性星宿角色的服饰、妆容细节。
鹤仙人：1:1 雕塑安置在店铺二层外侧，仙鹤人头、道袍、拂尘全部完整复刻。
彩塑钟馗：参考唐代陶俑、元代古画老虎纹样，彩陶质感，骑虎造型古朴厚重。
同时展出天命人玄铁全套铠甲、土地庙实景造景、黄风大圣对战蝮蝂的对战场景装置等。
门店总面积近千平米，采用展览 + 周边售卖的复合模式，营业时间为每日10:30‑18:30。作为国内少有的国产游戏大型线下实体空间，自去年开业以来，一直是玩家前往杭州的打卡地标。杨奇此前曾说在数字内容泛滥的时代，实体展品有其独有的价值。

《GTA》系列向来以真实的 开放世界 体验著称，很大一部分功劳要归功于NPC的行为表现。即将发售的《GTA6》将把这方面体验进一步强化。现已确认，大量全新动画将让每一位NPC的样貌、行为都各具特色。与此同时，我们也了解到更多关于这些角色行为逻辑的情报。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260831/1788131289_628807_jpg_r.jpg
NPC的反应会根据玩家武器是否外露而发生改变。部分NPC会主动靠近玩家，尝试夺走你的武器。另一些NPC则会直接逃跑或表现出恐惧。此前《GTA6》加长版演示就出现过该类场景，抢劫过程中有NPC靠近露西娅。
在试玩过程中，Mike与两名NPC发生打斗，其中一名NPC掉落帽子与眼镜。这些物品会留在地面，杰森可以走过去拾取并直接佩戴。这个功能在躲避警察追捕时，能用来改变主角外貌，起到伪装效果。
在试玩《GTA》期间，Mike观察了警察NPC的行为，发现不同警员身体素质存在明显差异。有一次，一名体型较胖的警察徒步追赶杰森，杰森成功甩开对方。回头时可以看见这名警察筋疲力尽，弯着腰气喘吁吁。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260831/1788131291_564774_jpg_r.jpg
加长版演示里那些冲击力十足的警车碰撞，全部都是无脚本触发。在试玩期间，罗布・纳尔逊向警车射击，每一次车辆的损毁、碰撞反馈效果都各不相同。他还重现了一次与预告片中类似的撞车事故。
Mike试玩时发现两种全新NPC行为。抢劫普通商铺时，如果玩家进行威胁，收银员会透露后屋有保险箱。玩家可以做出选择：要么去抢夺这笔数额更大的财物，要么直接带着已到手的现金逃走。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260831/1788131289_865613_jpg_r.jpg
《GTA6》开放世界还会触发随机犯罪事件：两名戴面具的女性抢劫珠宝店时陷入困境，向杰森和露西娅求助。玩家可以出手相助，然后趁机把珠宝占为己有。R星向Mike透露，哪怕是开发团队内部测试，他们自己连续好几个月都没能刷出这一随机事件。
《GTA6》NPC的服饰会匹配所在环境。Mike观察到，健身房周边的NPC大多身穿运动装。而在杰森居住的街区，NPC则是日常休闲穿搭。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 过去多年， 漫威 将其IP扩展到了电子游戏领域，不过成绩有好有坏，比如失败的《 漫威复仇者联盟 》以及大获成功的《漫威蜘蛛侠》系列以及即将发售的《漫威金刚狼》和将来的《漫威毒液》、《漫威钢铁侠》等。
最近又有报道称，漫威已经在开发一个新的《复仇者联盟》游戏了。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260909/1788906880_698309_jpg_r.jpg
据舅舅DanielRPK爆料，漫威正在筹备另一款《复仇者联盟》游戏。虽然目前关于这款游戏的信息还不多，但爆料人表示，这次SE和水晶动力都不会参与开发。此前水晶动力开发了《漫威复仇者联盟》游戏，SE发行，但惨败收场。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260909/1788906890_671181.webp
针对最近一条关于该项目的推文，爆料者表示目前他没有更多信息可以透露。因此，很难说漫威究竟打算如何处理这个项目。
值得一提的是，漫威虽然在《漫威复仇者联盟》游戏上折戟，但该公司并不惧怕尝试新事物，推出了《漫威斗魂》《漫威争锋》等格斗游戏，并且在开发这些大型 超级英雄 IP时，也乐于与其他开发商合作。
目前还无法预测该团队为下一部《复仇者联盟》游戏准备了什么，但随着《复仇者联盟：毁灭日》即将上映，或许这个项目会在不久的将来公布。

content.v: 近日在2026年PAX West游戏展上，SE举办主题为《从重聚到决意：打造FF7重制三部曲》座谈会，项目总监滨口直树、战斗总监远藤辉树登台，回顾整个重制项目开发历程，同时公开终章《最终幻想7：启示》战斗和系统细节，并明确表示三部曲完结不等于《最终幻想7》IP故事的终点。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260909/1788906356_276871_jpg_r.jpg
本次重制工程并非简单对1997原版游戏做高清翻新，核心目标是把《最终幻想7》传递给新一代玩家，希望该IP在未来二三十年依旧能够持续产出新内容，打造一个不断演化的长期IP宇宙，但现阶段尚未公布三部曲之后具体新项目形态。
针对终章核心的FITS战术服系统，滨口直树透露他否决了团队最初设计方案。开发组原本计划将战士、骑士、黑魔导士、召唤师这四套改变角色定位与招式的战术服作为通关、刷取奖励逐步解锁，滨口直树要求全部FITS套装开局直接解锁，不让玩家为解锁职业外观进行重复刷取，让玩家从游戏初期就自由尝试全部战斗流派。FITS系统会直接改变角色战斗动作、能力，同时保留魔石、装备原有养成体系，类似系列传统职业系统。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260909/1788906356_592611_jpg_r.jpg
本作职业中战士通过角色专属能力，拓展进攻玩法。黑魔道士擅长强力的属性魔法。骑士擅长防御和为队友提供支援。召唤士擅长召唤和连携攻击。本作中每个角色都可以通过职业来自定义战斗风格，该系统预计在游戏开始5-6个小时后解锁。除了职业系统所搭配的外观外，游戏里还有丰富的服装可收集。其中有些服装古怪有趣，玩家可在游玩过程中逐步解锁。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260909/1788906356_448362_jpg_r.jpg

《最终幻想7：启示》加入可操作角色西德与文森特，官方介绍了二人的战斗特色，文森特可以使用枪械，还能够变身加利安野兽形态，游戏也会进一步补全文森特过往背景故事；西德则侧重重火力近战输出。游戏保留卡牌小游戏“女王之血”， 开放世界 可以驾驶经典高空飞艇“疾风号”自由环游整个星球，陆行鸟Piko会跟随队伍成长，解锁探索与战斗能力，探索途中能够随时切换操控角色，部分任务交由不同队员完成，会带来剧情分支变化。
《最终幻想7：启示》将于2027年4月8日发售，登陆PS5、XSX|S、Switch2和PC平台。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 爆炸性的本杰明主唱停止了自己的演唱会，抱怨他与《辐射 4》模组制作者之间的不和
items.summary: Benjamin Burnley, lead singer and guitarist of the rock band Breaking Benjamin, took five minutes during a con

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/breaking-benjamin-frontman-stops-concert-to-shill-his-fallout-4-mod-1788904448830.jpg
Benjamin Burnley, lead singer and guitarist of the rock band Breaking Benjamin, took five minutes during a concert in Holmdel, New Jersey, to rant about his feud with a fellow Fallout 4 modder.

If you didn’t know Benjamin Burnley was a big gamer, now you do. He announced this information during a concert on Sunday, September 6, revealing that he’s an “amateur modder” for Skyrim and Fallout 4.

Lately, he’s been beefing with a fellow modder over a mod he recently created for Fallout 4 that allows users to play the game in first-person. He thinks it’s a pretty solid mod — but the other guy just doesn’t see the vision.
His spiel was caught on video by a fan at the concert, who posted footage of the moment on Reddit under the name ‘im_all_ears.’

“I just made a mod that makes it so that when you’re in first-person, you stay in first-person. You see your body in first-person. You go to your workshop area in first-person, and third-person still works. So, I want you to go and download that f**kin’ mod,” Burnley began.

“More importantly, I wanna tell you why I’m doing this. There was a modder — so, there’s like a clique, there was a modder in the community that was really mean to me and bullying me and saying, ‘Oh, you mod is sh*t, you don’t know what you’re f**kin’ doing, so I'm doing this every fucking night, and blowing his fucking downloads out of the water. Please help me destroy this f**kin’ jerk. I’m not even gonna say his name, but he’s a d**k, and f**k him.”
Production even posted the name of the mod on the venue’s big screen, along with Burnley's Nexus Mods username: “ True First Person Mod by killemloud.”

“Even if you don’t play that game, go download it. It’s on Nexus Mods,” he urged. “And tomorrow, I better see all those downloads going up. …This is for people who love mods. I’m uploading the update for it. You know, when you post a mod, you’re supposed to be able to grow and learn, and make it better. And right off the bat, this f**kin’ a**hole was s**tin’ on my mod, and he ain’t lettin’ me update it. So that’s what happened.”

While there were quite a few gamers in the crowd who couldn’t get enough of this humorous feud, one or two vocal fans yelled at Burnley to “play some music” rather than rant about Update 1.2 for his first-person mod. The entire spiel took nearly five minutes, and it has since gone viral across social media for the reasons you might expect.
“No way Ben makes Fallout 4 mods, that's insane lol,” one wrote on Reddit.
“Benjamin Burnley makes gaming mods?! The f**k? That’s awesome!” another said.

Breaking Benjamin was also famously featured in Halo 2, but there’s oodles of celebrity gamers out there; most recently, Obsession star Inde Navarrette went viral for having a Twitch channel, where she streamed games in the Call of Duty series and story-based titles like The Last of Us , while Samara Weaving — recently cast as Emma Frost in Marvel’s upcoming X-Men movie — received praise for being such a hardcore gamer that she takes her PlayStation 5 with her on the road while she’s filming movies.
Image Credits: David A. Smith/Getty Images

items.title: 发布后不到一周，《黎明行者之血》的开发商就已经开始制作续集
items.summary: Rebel Wolves is hiring.

content.v: With more than one million copies sold just a few days after its release, a "very positive" rating on Steama, and an enviable 83% review score from PC Gamer, vampiric horror RPG The Blood of Dawnwalker is a hit. And less than one week after its debut, developer Rebel Wolves is already planning what comes next.

Unsurprisingly, "what comes next" is more Dawnwalker: Jakub Szamałek, narrative director at developer Rebel Wolves, wrote on LinkedIn (via Dexerto ) that "we're not resting on our laurels," but are already thinking about where to take the game from here.

"I'm looking for a lead writer to help me and the narrative team craft the next chapter in the Dawnwalker saga," Szamałek wrote. "We're looking for someone who, to put it bluntly, writes EXCEPTIONALLY well, has a track record of excellence and experience in team management."

The job listing provides more detail about what's involved and it's heavy stuff, with responsibilities ranging from writing in-game documents and dialog to collaborating with the narrative director—that's Szamałek—and other team leads, and managing the entire writers team. You'll also need "a minimum of six years of experience as a writer/narrative designer in the video game industry with a track record of outstanding achievement."

That might sound like a lot for a studio that's only got one game under its belt, but remember that Rebel Wolves was founded by veterans of CD Projekt: Szamałek himself was principal writer on Cyberpunk 2077 , Thronebreaker, and the standalone release of Gwent, and before that earned writing credits on The Witcher 3 and its expansions. In fact, numerous CD Projekt personnel took time last week to offer congratulations on the game's launch .

items.title: 2026 年 Nintendo Switch 和 Switch 2 上的所有《塞尔达传说》游戏
items.summary: Every Zelda game you can check out on the Nintendo Switch, plus the new upgrades, games, and features coming t

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/01/29/zelda-games-on-switch-1706554892654.png

The Legend of Zelda is one of the most iconic video game series of all time. Starting on the Nintendo Entertainment System in 1986, The Legend of Zelda follows various incarnations of Princess Zelda and Link as they fight to save Hyrule from the evil that is Ganon. While the series has always been popular, the Nintendo Switch has catapulted Zelda into one of Nintendo's best-selling properties with landmark titles in Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom.

Echoes of Wisdom released toward the end of the original Nintendo Switch's life cycle, but Nintendo has already revealed quite a bit about the next generation of adventures in Hyrule. Here's every Legend of Zelda game on the Nintendo Switch as well as new Zelda games coming to the Switch 2 .
How Many Zelda Games Are on Nintendo Switch?

In total, five Zelda games, three Hyrule Warriors games, and one spin-off game have been released specifically for the Nintendo Switch . This includes both mainline entries and spinoff games that were released from 2017 to 2026. All of these Zelda games are playable on the Switch 2. The Ocarina of Time remake, releasing this November , will be the first Zelda game exclusive to the newer console.
All Zelda Switch Games in Order of Release Date
The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - 2017
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2020/10/26/01-tloz-botw-1603741775621.jpg

The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild was the first Zelda title released for Nintendo Switch. Launching alongside the system, this title marked a turning point in the Zelda series, bringing a style of open world gameplay that we'd never seen before. You can traverse to anywhere you can see in the world. Link awakes after a 100 year slumber, where he is tasked by the spirit of Hyrule's former King to save Princess Zelda from Calamity Ganon - a primal evil trapped inside Hyrule Castle.
Read our original review of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild or see what we thought of the Switch 2 version .
Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition - 2018
https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2018/03/09/switch-hyrulewarriorsdefinitiveedition-nd0308-scrn-06-1520554318585.jpg

Hyrule Warriors is an action hack and slash title developed by Omega Force and originally released for the Wii U. Characters from all kinds of Zelda games make an appearance, whether as playable characters or villains. The game was brought over to Nintendo Switch in 2018 in the form of Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition, and includes all characters, stages, and modes from the original game in addition to Breath of the Wild inspired costumes for Link and Zelda.
Read our review of Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition .
Cadence of Hyrule - 2019
https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2019/03/20/ze-1553099644352.png

Cadence of Hyrule is an extremely unqiue collaboration between Brace Yourself Games and Nintendo. The game combines the roguelike rhythm gameplay of Crypt of the NecroDancer with the world of The Legend of Zelda and its characters. This spinoff offers an incredible soundtrack and beautiful pixelated graphics. Up against Octavo, a musical villain, Zelda and Link team up with Cadence to thwart his plans and save the Hyrule.
Read our review of Cadence of Hyrule .
The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening - 2019
https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2019/09/20/links-awakening-1568999547330.jpg

The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening is a remake of 1993 Game Boy title developed by Grezzo. This charming platformer sees Link castaway at Koholint Island, where he must solve the mystery of the Wind Fish, a legendary being said to be on the island. Unlike some of the more modern Zelda titles, Link's Awakening takes you across many different dungeons and areas to collect the Instruments of the Sirens. If you never got the chance to play the original Link's Awakening, this is the definitive way to experience one of the Zelda series' most unique titles.
Read our review of The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening .
Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity - 2020
https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2020/09/08/switch-hyrulewarriorsageofcalamity-screenshot-02-1599584239583.jpg

The second Switch entry in the Hyrule Warriors series, Age of Calamity is set 100 years before the events of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. Here, you can experience firsthand the events that occured in the fight against Calamity Ganon. All of your favorite Breath of the Wild cahracters are here and playable, including Link, Zelda, the Champions, and so many more. Omega Force created a fun and expansive title, with two waves of DLC you can check out after completing the main story.
Read our review of Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity .
The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD - 2021
https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2021/02/22/switch-zeldasshd-nd-feb-scrn07-1614036051513.jpg

The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD is the long-awaited remaster of the classic Wii game . Set at the beginning of the Zelda timeline, Skyward Sword takes Link to the skies as he traverses across the world to save his childhood friend Zelda. You'll uncover the Master Sword was created as part of this journey, among other things. The remaster includes the iconic motion controls you can operate with the Joy-Con and a new button-only gameplay style for those looking to play without motion.
Read our review of The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD .
The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - 2023
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2023/12/14/totk-thumb-1702592817092.png

The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom hit the market in 2023, selling over 10 million copies in just three days as well as quite a few special edition Switch consoles . Set a few years after the events of Breath of the Wild, Link is tasked once again with finding Princess Zelda after Ganondorf is resurrected. Tears of the Kingdom takes to both the skies of Hyrule and the depths below the land. This creates one of the largest maps you'll find in any game, leaving for hundreds of hours of exploration to be had. All in all, it's the best Zelda game of all time and a hard one to follow.
Read our original review of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom or see what we thought about the Switch 2 version .
The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom - 2024
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/09/24/zeldaechoesofwisdom-blogroll-1727216523372.jpg

But, of course, Tears of the Kingdom was not the end of this beloved Nintendo franchise on the original Switch. The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom was announced during the June 2024 Nintendo Direct before launching on the Switch in the fall later that year. While Echoes has the titular Princess take the story's reigns, and features a more 2D art style à la Link's Awakening, it should not be mistaken as a spin-off or side project. This is a full-blown, magical Zelda game, that lets you unlock your creativity to try and save Link and the rest of Hyrule in entirely new ways.
Read our review of The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom .
Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment - 2025
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/11/04/gzazixgq2n0rlbey2j6inya4vwsjvwedclftziw0iia-1762216682035.jpg

The latest Zelda-adjacent release is a new entry in the Hyrule Warriors series. Nintendo has heavily emphasized that the story is canon, giving us a deeper look at the Imprisoning War in what is essentially a prequel to Tears of the Kingdom. You get to play as a spread of different characters , including Princess Zelda, who has been sent into Hyrule's past and must work with new allies in the fight against Ganandorf.
Read our review of Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment

items.title: 我们在《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版游戏镜头中注意到的 40 个变化
items.summary: Here are 40 changes we saw when comparing Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 to the N64 version, from things as large

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/frame-1788896769216.png

Nintendo showed roughly 20 minutes of footage from the Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time in the Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct this morning . Producer Eiji Aonuma said this project is largely a faithful remake of the N64 classic, reborn on Switch 2 with modern controls and a strong focus on detail. But even though the remake appears to stick closely to the bones of its source material, there are plenty of minor additions and changes I noticed when scrubbing back through the footage for a couple of hours following the Direct.

Here are 40 changes I saw when comparing Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 to the N64 version, from things as large as the art style all the way to small menu changes and UI differences. This list mostly goes in chronological order, starting with the gameplay demonstration from Aonuma and ending with the new trailer that closed the presentation.

A brief warning : I talk in general terms about some items and locations from the original Ocarina of Time. So, if you want absolutely zero knowledge of these things before playing for yourself, stay away!
1. A Redesigned World
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/firstlook-oot-1788896524681.png

Obviously, the biggest difference in the remake is its visuals. Aonuma opened his gameplay demo with a look at Kokiri Forest, where the game begins. Everything is more detailed: there are paved stone paths, defined wooden staircases that used to be low-texture ramps, grass blowing in the wind, forest spirits gliding through the air, and modern sunlight seeping through the trees. It's definitely a brand new take on the first 3D Hyrule, especially compared to the 3DS version that essentially just spruced up the original visuals.
2. A Redesigned Hero
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/linkredesign-oot-1788896524680.png

Link himself has seen a similarly significant overhaul. We saw lots of Child Link in the gameplay -- with snippets of Adult Link showing up in the full trailer later on -- and he looks a lot different. His woven green tunic has multiple layers now, with patterns sewn in and flourishes at the bottom. He wears a feather in his hair and has various beads throughout his outfit. I personally love how Link looks now. I think the uncanny art style of the blocky N64 originally shines through brilliantly in this interpretation. We see his mannerisms throughout the gameplay -- like stretching when he's left idle for too long, or putting his hands on his hips when speaking to someone -- and I think he perfectly embodies the spirit of the Hero of Time.
3. A Bigger Wallet to Start
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/largerwallet-1788896524679.png

N64 Ocarina sets you off with a pretty small wallet that can only hold 99 rupees. That's pretty annoying, especially when you open a treasure chest that contains a high-value rupee that you aren't able to fit in your wallet, making it go to waste. On Switch 2, we see Link dive down and grab a blue rupee (worth five, of course) and add it to his wallet, which is shown to have a maximum capacity of 200. I'm sure we'll still upgrade our wallets through the Gold Skulltula questline, but this is a much better start!
4. Remappable Shortcuts
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/linkredesign-oot-1788896524680.png

On the left side of the new equipment screen, we see a grid of four empty slots (Link just doesn't have the matching items at the start of the game) that appear to be mapped to the top and bottom directional buttons on the left Joy-Con (or the D-pad on the Pro Controller). Later in the gameplay, we see that the Ocarina and Navi are each mapped to one of the left and right directional buttons, but the top and bottom are blank. It would appear that these are going to be shortcuts for equipment earned later in the adventure. I have to imagine this is the solution for swapping boots on the fly (more on that later), but I'm puzzled at what the other slots could be for, given that there are only two special sets of boots to find in the original. We'll have to wait and see.
5. Camera Control
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/rockguy-1788896524680.png

As Aonuma pointed out, it feels silly to spend time discussing free camera movement in a 2026 game, but it's a huge addition to Ocarina of Time. He demonstrated spinning the camera fully around Link, giving us a look at the poor kid trying to lift rocks for the great Mido. Camera control alone will make the Ocarina remake feel like a significantly different game, especially in stealth sections and tricky platforming moments.
6. Expanded Dialogue
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/dialogue-1788896524680.png

The Direct made a point to emphasize that characters in Ocarina of Time will have a lot more to say. This is one of the changes I'm most excited about: the dialogue text speed in the original is painfully slow by today's standards, and characters don't have a ton to talk about. I'm excited to see how additional dialogue will add to Zelda's characters and world. Even though the remake is largely a faithful adaptation of the original, it's changes like these that will make it incredibly exciting to dive into as someone who's played the N64 version at least a dozen times.
7. A Dedicated Jump Button
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/jump-1788897653283.png

Like the camera control, a dedicated jump button is another mechanical game changer. Jumping is mapped to X -- just like the default in Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kindgom -- and this will surely change how we experience Hyrule. There's a lot of platforming sections in Ocarina's dungeons, and being able to jump and control the camera will do a lot of heavy lifting to make the remake feel modern. I'm a big game feel guy -- the weight and maneuverability of a character matters a lot to me -- and I'm so excited to zip around Hyrule with the new controls at my disposal.
8. Faster Swim Speed and Altered Swim Meter
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/swimmeter-1788896524679.png

Link can also do a little boost to up his swim speed, and I noticed a change to the diving meter's UI. On N64, a three-second countdown timer appeared at the top of the screen when diving. Now, it's a vertical swim stamina bar that appears right next to Link. It's still split into three chunks, so it's likely the same amount of time, but it's a small visual difference.
9. No Loading Screens in Buildings
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/noloadshop-1788896524679.png

Aonuma pointed out that the team chose to keep loading screens between large areas to maintain the spirit of the original. But in towns, you can seamlessly walk into stores with no loading screens, which is a huge improvement. We see Link roll right into the shop in Kokiri Forest, which looks similar to entering buildings in Breath of the Wild.
10. Redesigned Inventory Screen
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/inventory-1788896524679.png

I'm sure Zelda theorists are already hard at work placing every known item from Ocarina of Time onto this newly-designed inventory screen. Based on the Deku Stick's placement in the top left corner, it seems the shape of the background indicates what item goes there. I see a boomerang-shaped icon to the bottom right of the Deku Sticks, three hexagonal shapes that look perfect for the spells you earn from Fairy Fountains, and five slots on the bottom row that look perfect for empty bottles. But aren't there only four empty bottles in the original game? Hmm...
11. An Expanded Shop?
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/08/shoptrainingroom-1788896524678.png

As Link is turning to leave the shop in Kokiri Forest, we see what looks like a training dummy on his left. Not only that, there appears to be an entrance to a back room of sorts next to that, which wasn't present on N64. Maybe some buildings could be slightly expanded?

items.title: 《千层地狱》是一场讲述地狱故事的“战术叙事”盛宴，但它的失败却让人感觉残酷
items.summary: From the developer of King of Dragon Pass, a gorgeously imagined meat grinder for hapless adventuring parties.

content.v: In Thousand Hells: The Underworld heists, I've sort of taken on the role of the dad in that one tweet about feeding cats to coyotes. But rather than serving up pets to jackals, I'm dutifully feeding bands of doomed adventurers into the psychological, corporeal, and spiritual wood chipper of the "tactical narrative" game's bespoke hellscapes.

Those hellscapes—from the primordial twilight taigas of the Midnight North, to the melting fever-dream dominion of the Hell of Nightmares—form a mesmerizing kaleidoscope of abyssal imagination. Made by the developer behind the phenomenal King of Dragon Pass and Six Ages games , its pedigree is obvious as each game guides my hand-picked party of hell raiders through encounters rich with the implied culture, tradition, and history of their respective afterlives. I just wish I weren't spending quite as much time feeling like my efforts are futile.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3wQ45Ektk4ud9YtPFFJTie.jpg

A game of Thousand Hells, designed for quicker, more repeatable sessions than developer A Sharp's prior work, begins in the Eternal City, a metropolis where the thousand worlds conjoin, and from which daring (or foolish) heroes can embark for their thousand associated underworlds. After a quick character creation process, I'm given a task by a benefactor—reclaiming the spirits of two murdered princes, for example—that I'll need to embark into one of four hells to complete.

If I hope to have any chance of survival, however, I'll need a party, gathered through a team-building process in which I'm cobbling together an incomplete picture of my potential recruits' talents and traits. Those traits will serve as Thousand Hells' basic gameplay mechanic: As my party and I embark for more demonic climes, I'll be playing our traits as game tiles during the randomized set of turn-based trials we'll encounter.

The better those traits match the task at hand, the better my dice roll will be for surpassing a challenge. If my party finds itself being forced to navigate a storm-tossed chthonic undersea, I'll have better odds nominating our sailor or scout to direct us than our streetwise poet with a profound fear of water.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/q3ghnhZk5FovQiUsPTbXz.jpg

When I find myself with a well-rounded party, Thousand Hells feels like the unfolding of my own personal mythological epic, weaving together heroics and improvised cunning with a tapestry of otherworldly creatures and crises. My parties have hewed the head from a titanic eel on the banks of an ocean that has never known the light of day. I've bartered for my safety with a swarm of brain-bats by offering the pickled thinking organs of a renowned philosopher. I've looted the tomb of a tyrant-king after breaking the spell that kept his murdered slaves in ages of spectral servitude.

More often than I'd like, however, starting a new game will ultimately mean watching with growing frustration as my party is slowly ripped apart by a series of consecutive defeats when their randomized traits don't prove applicable to their particular quest's encounters.

The main issue is that, despite leaving the Eternal City with a party of four, I can only nominate one of my characters to do most of the work in any given encounter. They'll be able to randomly draw on one trait from each of their comrades, but it often means an unlucky initial shuffling of talents leave me with the sour-tasting suspicion that a run wouldn't have been doomed if just one of the skills that was wasted on my shaman was possessed by my cutpurse instead.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/AGG3SbKFHZVUNstJFzeC5A.jpg

Even if I've picked a warrior well-suited for a duel with a bronze-skinned guardian demon, that doesn't mean the talents most crucial for my champion's victory will present themselves when I need them. He might be combat trained, but if I keep drawing tiles tied to his ugliness and religious devotion when all I need is his sword arm to swing, that demon will be free to dismember him without much trouble. And his injuries will only make his chances worse if there's something else that needs stabbing later in our quest.

Thousand Hells boasts some truly best-in-class procedural storytelling, but it's content to subject me to back-to-back miseries without recourse. Its hellscapes are worth the price of admission—but it's a price with a punishingly sharp edge.
Thousand Hells: The Underworld Heists is available on Steam now.

items.title: 受到《Clair Obscur: Expedition 33》等游戏成功的启发，法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙宣称“电子游戏是我们文化的一部分”，并宣布举办新的国际游戏节
items.summary: It seems like Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 really made an impact on Macron.

content.v: One of the biggest videogames of 2025 was Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 , a French JRPG that sold millions of copies, won armloads of awards, and earned not just one but two separate shout-outs from French President Emmanuel Macron. It must've made an even bigger impression on him than it first appeared, as over the weekend Macron announced a new "international videogame festival" that will take place in France.

Macron made the announcement during an address at the Lumiere Summit (via GamesRadar ), a conference where governments, businesses, creators, and "cultural institutions" can collaborate on the future of "cinema and the moving image." I assume that last bit is a just-missed translation of "motion picture," because that's clearly what the conference is about, but regardless, Macron used the moment to reveal his ambitions for a related-but-different effort.

"I firmly believe that videogames are part of our culture," Macron said (Google translated), adding that games should be considered part of France's cultural heritage, just as movies and "other creative endeavors" already are.

"Therefore, we will create an international videogame festival conceived from the outset as a major global event for creativity, innovation, gamers, and the industry. The great global successes of French videogames remind us of the richness of this creative endeavor, this creativity, which is also an industry. We must further celebrate it and strive to gain everyone's support."
Parce que les jeux vidéo font partie de notre culture, nous allons créer un festival international du jeu vidéo. pic.twitter.com/45g7UYfOzk September 7, 2026

Macron didn't mention Clair Obscur by name, but that has to be at the top of his mind. There's really no bigger outwardly French videogame of the moment, and as I said, he's called it out publicly at least twice in the past.

But there are an awful lot of other really good made-in-France videogames out there. Ubisoft, headquartered in Saint-Mandé, France, makes quite a few of them, and there's also the Plague Tale series, Rematch , Jusant , Chants of Sennaar , Sifu , Stray , and casting a little further back, the biggest and best of them all (and this is not up for discussion), Another World.

Details of Macron's proposed new showcase weren't shared, but he did offer some insight into what he called " profound upheavals " in film, television, animation, and videogames, including artificial intelligence and the advent of platforms—I imagine a reference to things like Roblox, Netflix, and Paramount if it ever manages to complete the Warner acquisition—that "are transforming our habits."

"Faced with challenges that know no borders, no nation can act alone. That is why, in Saint-Paul-de-Vence, France and South Korea—two great nations of creation committed to cultural diversity and their sovereignty—are bringing together those who create, produce, finance, distribute, innovate, and decide. Our ambition: to forge new alliances between creators and technologies, public and private actors, cinema, television, platforms, and video games. So that this revolution opens up new possibilities without homogenizing our imaginations."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/mVYMeRKWypiKrmxKrbmzHP.png

France already has one big videogame festival, Paris Games Week, but it's possible Macron is envisioning something more in the way of a cultural exchange program rather than a business-oriented event. We'll have to wait and see for that, just as we're now waiting to see what Clair Obscur developer Sandfall Interactive gets up to next .
